entries.value: "The `bsc session` CLI (#architect-starts-and-stops-system-sessions): start · stop · list the app-owned SYSTEM SESSIONS (designer, librarian, architect, sound-designer, integrator). The id is an ENUM resolved against a closed registry and refused outside it — that closed set is what makes the verb safe to grant to the architect, which ingests raw user prose. Tauri-free; rides the shared bsc-appchan transport."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# The ONE bsc→app request channel — shared with `bsc shot`/`bsc navigate`/`bsc fleet`, so there is no
# `bsc session ask` opens a LOOP and `bsc session reply` posts into one
# (#an-ask-is-a-loop-again-and-every-turn-is-delivered). The dependency runs THIS WAY ONLY: making
# `bsc loop say` deliver would need bsc-loop to resolve a participant to a session and reach the app,
# which is the reverse edge and a cycle. Keeping both verbs here leaves `bsc loop` a generic
# conversation store that knows nothing about system sessions.
